verdict.rationale: On the Claude API, skills are referenced by `skill_id` with an optional `version`, and there is a Skill Versions API for version management, so teams can pin a specific skill version. In Claude Code, plugin manifests carry a version and plugins are described as supporting "versioned releases", but marketplaces advertise automatic updates and nothing shows how to pin or freeze an installed plugin or skill. missing for 10: lockfile mechanism, documented way to pin or disable auto-updates for Claude Code plugin/marketplace skills, detail on version-pinning semantics (e.g., what happens when `version` is omitted), independent corroboration.
